# SEO research: lab grown diamonds (fast mode, 2026-10-29)

Source: DataForSEO SERP (5 cities), Google Ads volume and Labs keyword difficulty (Australia). Page notes via DataForSEO on_page_instant_pages (Firecrawl out of credits, so headings and counts only, no body text). GSC not read (fast mode).

## Australia (Sydney, Melbourne)
| # | Sydney | Melbourne |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | kavalri.com.au shop | kavalri.com.au shop |
| 2 | koodak.com.au supplies shop | michaelhill.com.au sale page |
| 3 | cullenjewellery.com education | argylejewellers.com.au shop |
| 4 | annys.com.au lab-grown vs natural (Sep 2026) | vyor.com.au 'Are lab-grown diamonds real?' |
| 5 | cullenjewellery.com lab vs mined | marieclaire.com.au where to buy |
Shopping intent dominates, with local packs. Every informational page in the AU top 10 is written by a jeweller selling lab-grown (or both). No AI overview or PAA returned in AU.

## United States (New York)
AI overview leads: real diamond, HPHT/CVD, graded by GIA/IGI, percentage savings (YouTube-sourced), lower resale, then names retailers. Organic is all retailers. PAA: Are lab-grown diamonds considered real diamonds? Is it worth buying a lab-grown diamond? What is the downside of a lab-grown diamond? Why do jewelers not like lab diamonds?

## Middle East (Dubai)
Local jewellers, Instagram, Reddit, popular products. PAA: Are lab grown diamonds legal? Are lab grown diamonds of any value? What are lab grown diamonds called?

## Asia (Singapore)
Retail, marketplaces, one editorial (Her World 2024). PAA: Are lab grown diamonds called cubic zirconia? How do I know if my lab diamond is CVD or HPHT? Can a pawn shop tell if a diamond is lab created?

## Cross-region summary
- Intent: head term is transactional everywhere; the informational sub-intent is 'is it real', 'is it worth it', 'downside', 'value', 'how to tell'.
- Pricing shown: almost every result shows prices or percentage savings. We show none (brief rule); that is also a differentiator.
- Top concern: is it real and does it hold value; secondary: what is it called, can someone tell, is it legal.
- Gap we can own: no top result is neutral. None cites the FTC naming rule or Australian Consumer Law; none qualifies 'sustainable/ethical' claims; none frames heirloom and sentiment as values. A non-seller 'worth it if / think twice if' page is unique in the AU SERP.

## Decision: who targets 'lab grown vs natural diamond'
This post. The query is a decision query (1,000/month, KD 4) and this post is the deeper decision page; the buying guide keeps a short lab-grown H2 that links here with a descriptive anchor, and should drop 'lab grown vs natural diamond' from its secondary keywords to avoid two pages competing.
